title: Kill every process an EVA-03 job started at timeout, cancellation and exit
goal: No process started by an EVA-03 job survives its timeout, cancellation or exit, including one in its own session
acceptance: Test committed failing first: a job's child in its own session (detached, setsid) is gone after timeout and after cancellation
The runner tracks the job's descendants while it runs, kills every one at the end, verifies none survive, and records a survivor as an uncertain effect instead of claiming a clean end
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-19 after the probe (two child processes, timeout and cancel). Not a measurement. Review of PR #549 (2026-11-19) fixed in the same PR; containment stated as best effort.
